name: opencode-docs
body:
The opencode 2.x dependency documentation: `README.md`'s dependency line, `apg init` section, and querying-from-opencode section, and `AGENTS.md`'s CLI section. Both name opencode 2.x and the `@opencode/plugin` dependency, state the plugin install location `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` alongside the shared lib and the seven distributed agents, and state the apg-release-to-opencode version pairing (`requirements.constraint.opencode-v2-support-window`: the apg 0.21.x line supports opencode v1, the apg 0.22.x line supports opencode v2), keeping the restart-opencode-after-init note.

A NARROW owner distinct from `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` (the roster count and the push/tag user-doc half) and `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (the frontend dependency contract): this component owns the opencode-2.x-dependency and version-pairing statements alone.

implemented-by: `README.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
